# Specific paths under home are not blocked (only the bare home dir is)
rm -rf /tmp/build
rm -rf node_modules
rm -rf $HOME/Downloads/old.zip
rm -rf ~/.cache/foo
rm -rf /home/dev/projects/scratch
# Single-file delete
rm file.txt
rm -f /tmp/old.log
# Non-recursive
rm /tmp/file
# Glob with explicit parent path
rm -rf build/*
rm -rf dist/*
# Not rm at all
echo "rm -rf /" > note.txt
grep "rm -rf" history.log
